notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 notes
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed aim calculation.
[*]Changed time calculation to use in-game time from real time.
[*]Reduced the frame rate drop when using weapons.
[/list]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*]Added tutorial message on first clear or death.
[*]Changed the tutorial message.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the description of the shotgun in the guide. (only Japanese)
[*]Fixed an issue where the leaderboard / weapon UI was difficult to see depending on the screen ratio.
[/list]

[b]WorldSelect[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the teleporter for weapon stages other than Wind.
[*]Changed some design.
[/list]

[b]World1[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the tree collision size.
[/list]

[b]World3[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the water damage in Stage1 fluctuates depending on the frame rate.
[*]Fixed unintended behavior of gimmick in Stage1.
[*]Fixed stage production in Stage2.
[/list]

[b]World4[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed difficult to aim in Stage2.
[/list]

[b]World5[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the fog setting.
[*]Fixed unintended behavior of enemies in Stage1.
[/list]

[b]World6[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the texture setting in Terminal.
[*]Fixed material settings in Stage3.
[/list]

[b]World7[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the size of DestructibleMesh in Stage1.
[*]Fixed difficult to aim in Stage1.
[/list]

[b]World9[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed difficult to aim in Terminal.
[*]Reduced the frame rate drop in Stage1.
[*]Reduced the frame rate drop in Stage2.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 notes
notes.notes:
[h1] WorldSelect [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added two tutorials for new users. (How to unlock the weapon / How to open the door)
[*] The position of the entrance of the Wind stage has been changed.
[*] Adjusted the placement of objects around World2.
[*] Adjusted some area.
[/list]

[h1] Other [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you were spawning at an unintended location when launching.
[/list]

[h1] * Caution * [/h1]
If you have already played, the tutorials added this time will be cleared.
Also note that the entrance position of the Wind stage has been changed to near the tutorial stage.
